title: SoulPowers
description: SoulPowers is a Minecraft RPG plugin adding unique Souls with powerful abilities, custom items, particles, cooldowns, and progression. Players unlock new powers as they level up and dominate PvP battles.
body:
# 🌌 SoulPowers

**A powerful RPG-style Soul ability system for Minecraft servers**

SoulPowers introduces a completely new **Soul progression system** where every player gains supernatural abilities based on the Soul they choose. Each Soul unlocks powerful abilities, unique items, visual effects, and progression mechanics that evolve as the player levels up.

Perfect for **RPG servers, SMPs, PvP worlds, and adventure gameplay**.

---

# ✨ Main Features

### 🔮 Soul Selection

Players can choose their destiny using the **/soul command**.
Each Soul grants unique abilities, items, and playstyles.

Available Souls:

🔥 Fire Soul – destructive flame abilities
❄️ Ice Soul – freezing control powers
🌿 Nature Soul – healing and summoning abilities
⚡ Storm Soul – lightning and speed powers
🌌 Galaxy Soul – cosmic and gravity manipulation

---

# ⚔️ Ability System

SoulPowers currently includes **26 unique abilities** across all Souls.

Each ability includes:

• Custom particles
• Unique sounds
• Visual combat effects
• Ability cooldowns
• Level unlock requirements

Abilities are activated by **right-clicking with special power items**.

---

# 🧰 Power Items

Every ability is represented by a **unique item**.

Examples:

• Blaze Rod → Fire abilities
• Packed Ice → Ice abilities
• Leaves → Nature abilities
• Lightning Rod → Storm abilities
• End Rod → Galaxy abilities

These items act as **ability triggers** when right-clicked.

---

# 📈 Level Progression

Players grow stronger as they level up.

✔ New abilities unlock automatically
✔ Power items update when leveling
✔ Stronger abilities become available later

This creates a **true RPG progression system** inside Minecraft.

---

# 🛡️ Item Protection System

SoulPowers ensures players never lose their abilities.

✔ Power items **cannot be dropped**
✔ Power items **do not drop on death**
✔ Items **automatically return on respawn**

Your Soul powers are always with you.

---

# 🎮 Gameplay Style

SoulPowers transforms Minecraft into a **true RPG combat experience**.

Players will:

⚔️ Unlock abilities
🌟 Master their Soul powers
📈 Progress through levels
🔥 Dominate PvP battles

---
